_note: English is the reference language. Every key here must also exist in hi.json and te.json (checked by test/i18n.test.js). Wording marked 'exact' in the PRD must not be changed.
app.name: GoldenHour
app.tagline: A 60-second stroke warning-sign check for families.
app.disclaimer: GoldenHour is a screening aid that prompts people to seek emergency care. It is not a diagnostic device and does not replace a doctor.
banner.demo: DEMO MODE — calls go to {name}, not 108
banner.demoNotSet: DEMO MODE — no demo number saved. Calling is off.
common.saveFailed: Could not save on this phone. Check that storage is allowed for this site.
install.purpose: Turns any family member into a stroke first responder in about 60 seconds. Works offline.
install.openInChromeHint: The Install button works only in Chrome on Android. If nothing happens, use the ⋮ menu → Install app.
install.done: Installed. Open GoldenHour from your home screen.
language.title: Choose your language
home.emergencyCheckHint: Someone suddenly looks unwell? Start here.
placeholder.title: Not built yet
placeholder.check: The emergency check is not part of this version yet. Nothing was tested and no alert was sent.
placeholder.baseline: Baseline recording is not part of this version yet.
placeholder.realEmergency: If this is a real emergency, call 108 from your phone's dialer now.
settings.title: Settings
settings.demoLocked: Always on in this prototype. Calls never go to 108.
settings.demoNumberHint: A teammate's mobile on a different phone. Never 108, 112 or any helpline.
settings.hospitalHint: A teammate's mobile. Never a real hospital.
settings.addDemoNumber: Add a demo emergency number to enable calling.
settings.demoNameRequired: Enter the name of the person who will answer the demo call.
settings.keyHint: Saved only on this phone. Never put keys in code or share them.
settings.developerHint: Shows raw numbers and calibration tools.
settings.resetConfirm: Delete all GoldenHour data on this phone? This cannot be undone.
error.phone_emergency_blocked: Demo Mode: emergency numbers are blocked. Enter a teammate's mobile.
error.phone_invalid: Enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
error.ageInvalid: Enter an age between 0 and 120, or leave it empty.
error.consentRequired: Please tick the box to confirm they agree.
error.maxContacts: You can save up to 5 contacts.
profile.title: Medical profile
profile.intro: The facts an emergency doctor needs in the first minutes.
profile.fictional: Hackathon demo: enter fictional data only, for example Lakshmi, 68.
profile.name: Name
profile.otherConditionsHint: For example a previous stroke or a heart rhythm problem.
profile.privacy: GoldenHour stores this information only on this phone. It is shared only if you send an emergency alert.
profile.consent: The person being protected agrees to this setup.
contacts.title: Emergency contacts
contacts.intro: Up to 5 people who are alerted during a HIGH ALERT.
contacts.demoRule: Demo rule: add only teammates or friends who agreed to receive test messages. Never real relatives or strangers.
contacts.empty: No contacts yet. Add at least one.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.primaryHint: Alerted first. Exactly one contact is primary.
contacts.livesNearbyHint: Nearby contacts are asked to come now. Others get hospital details.
home.progressHint: Finish setup while everyone is healthy.
home.progressDone: Setup complete. Ready for an emergency.
arm.title: Arm test
arm.place.left: Sit down. Place the phone flat on your open LEFT palm, screen up, top of the phone pointing to your fingertips. Stretch the arm straight out in front at shoulder height.
arm.place.right: Now the other side. Place the phone flat on your open RIGHT palm, screen up, top of the phone pointing to your fingertips. Stretch the arm straight out in front at shoulder height.
arm.helperNote: Helper: stand close to catch the phone. Do not support the arm. Do not hold the phone yourself — the result would mean nothing.
arm.placedButton: Phone is on the palm — start
arm.waitingReady: Hold the phone flat and still…
arm.readyHint: The test starts by itself when the phone is flat and still. If they cannot hold it, tap the button below.
arm.closeEyes: Close your eyes and hold still.
arm.openEyes: Open your eyes and lower your arm.
arm.cannotDoConfirm: Mark the arm test as not completed? This counts as a warning sign.
arm.result.notCompleted: Could not complete the arm test — treat this as a warning sign.
arm.result.dropped: The arm fell or the phone dropped — treat this as a warning sign.
arm.result.noSensors: This phone's motion sensors are not available. Arm test: not tested.
arm.result.invalid: Not enough sensor data was received. Arm test: not tested.
